name: Expectation Reality
author: TheGrizard
tagline: generative percussion: four parts, one button, endless grooves
description: Expectation Reality makes endless percussion: four parts (KICK, SNARE, PERC, HATS), each a pattern on its own length (polymeters) from a groove map, Euclidean rhythms, a Turing machine or broken IDM groupings, driving one of twelve synthesised drum engines. REC deals a groove that loops exactly; EVOLVE brings in its step components, then rewrites it. Made to play under After Images: it follows its clock and hears its notes. Punch-ins on the keys, randomisers on the black keys, a kick-sidechained tape compressor, a glitch delay.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita. A partner to After Images.
